build.version_note: `lightsim --version` is not an option of the 0.1.0 CLI (it prints the usage); the version is the first line of `lightsim info`. Python package: lightsim.__version__ = 0.1.0
build.build: cargo build --release -p lightsim-cli --features cuda; maturin develop --release --features cuda (fresh clone of the public repository)

method: each timing repeated at least three times in separate processes, best reported; a run counts only if the GPUs it uses were idle (utilisation <= 10 %, no other compute process) just before it started; every lightsim run passed the runner's end-of-run field-energy check (finite fields), which fails the run otherwise
purpose: single-GB10 references for the multi-node rows: the per-node slabs and the full grids
